sloka: तम् चतुर्भिः खरः क्रुद्धो रामम् गात्रेषु मार्गणैः ।विव्याध हृदि मर्मज्ञो मातंगम् इव तोमरैः ॥३-२८-२४॥
transliteration: tam caturbhiḥ kharaḥ kruddho rāmam gātreṣu mārgaṇaiḥ ।vivyādha hṛdi marmajño mātaṁgam iva tomaraiḥ ॥3-28-24॥

translations.english: Quite enraged, Khara who knew how to hit the tender parts (of the body) in an encounter sent out four arrows on Rama. It was like poking an elephant's limbs with a javelin.
